confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'the issue appears to lie with the start control side of the system'

blockingLoop.evidence: Kept asking about power, door recognition, child lock, latch and delay start after the customer repeatedly said only the door drops

rationale: The customer repeatedly said the washing works and the problem is the door dropping after a twang. They also reported a loose spring hanging on the right side. The assistant ignored this, asked irrelevant questions about child lock, delay start and the latch, then concluded the fault was in the 'start control side', which contradicts the evidence. It never mentioned the broken hinge spring, asked for the full model, or gave spring-tension safety advice, so the escalation was generic and misdirected.
